source.title: Complete dataset for MACE: Automated Assessment of Stereochemistry of Transition Metal Complexes and its Applications in Computational Catalysis

selection: For Mn and Ru, use the first ten backbone/substituent strata in the declared Me-then-iPr order and retain numerically first two tridentate configurations per stratum. Source inputs only; no production outcomes used.

truth_protocol.proper_rotations: derive determinant-positive signed permutation matrices independently; enumerate all 720 donor/slot assignments and minimize proper Kabsch residual
truth_protocol.mirror: coordinate reflection through x=0; independent reference comparisons use proper rotations only after reflection
truth_protocol.degenerate_or_uncertified: typed unresolved result, never select the nearest pose without passing both limits
truth_protocol.local_shape_partition: 30 OH poses before quotient by molecular donor-equivalence maps; do not equate source configuration IDs with distinct chemical classes
truth_protocol.registered_slot_order_basis: The existing independently audited OH convention is +z,-z,+x,+y,-x,-y. This fixed change of basis converts the separately declared +x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z fitting coordinates before constructing a production frame; no predictions used.
truth_protocol.source_local_frame_policy: Retain every source-declared tetrahedral frame using a parser that preserves source tags; validate its orientation independently from coordinates, including coordinate-row witnesses for owner-scoped implicit H. One global map must satisfy all supplied frames.

annotation_conventions: MACE donor isotopes 1..6 are coordination-slot annotations, not mass numbers. Atom maps in exported XYZ JSON identify coordinate rows. Strip donor slot isotopes and map numbers from chemical identity; preserve mapping in source evidence.
claim_boundary: Generated source chemical structures, not experimental stability or an untouched discovery holdout. Validate the full source-declared configured inventory (OH plus supplied local frames) by independent geometric and constitutional transport; no blind-perception or unsupplied-configuration claim.
overlap_status: Input-only overlap audit complete before production evaluation; no selected record overlaps ACS/CIP/RotA or prior designed negatives
